name: Lark Belfry
tagline: The command deck for the small congregation with a very large calling.
positioning: Lark Belfry unifies membership rolls, giving, and the Sunday service order into one calm workspace built for the solo pastor and the volunteer-run parish.

hero.h1: Run your whole ministry from one quiet screen.
hero.sub: Lark Belfry replaces the four spreadsheets, three group chats, and one anxious notebook that hold your church together. Membership, giving, and the order of service — finally in harmony.

features.title: Living Membership Rolls
features.description: Every family, baptism date, and pastoral note in one place. Search a name and see their entire story with your congregation instantly.

features.title: Giving Without the Guilt Trip
features.description: Track tithes, one-time gifts, and pledges, then generate year-end statements in a single click. No accounting degree required.

features.title: The Sunday Composer
features.description: Drag hymns, readings, and sermon notes into an order of service your worship team actually reads on their phones.

features.title: Gentle Reminders
features.description: Automated nudges for volunteer rotations, visitation follow-ups, and the flowers nobody remembered to reorder.

features.title: The Parish Calendar
features.description: Weddings, funerals, potlucks, and building bookings on one shared timeline the whole leadership team can trust.

features.title: Your Data, Your Flock
features.description: Encrypted records, granular permissions, and a full export anytime. Your congregation's trust is not a feature we rent back to you.

testimonials.quote: I used to spend Monday morning reconciling the offering count against a spreadsheet and a shoebox. Lark Belfry gave me those hours back to actually visit the sick.
testimonials.name: Rev. Marcus Elwood

testimonials.quote: Our year-end giving statements once took three volunteers a full weekend. Now I press one button and go home. The board thinks I hired someone.
testimonials.name: Diane Okafor

testimonials.quote: The Sunday Composer means my worship team stops texting me at 11pm asking what key the closing hymn is in. Worth it for that alone.
testimonials.name: Caleb Rhodes
